HOSTING_FEATURES_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the features dimension: hosting.features.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

featuresAtomInUnfed.doc: a non-MIDI atom input no buffer here can feed

text.en: This plugin declares a non-MIDI atom input that nothing here can feed. Run it where that input can be fed, or accept it stays empty.

featuresDisqualifying.doc: unsuitable: the plugin requires a feature the host refuses to provide on the audio thread (a disqualifying one, or one that pins the quantum where the quantum is not pinned); the record names them

text.en: This plugin needs a host feature this host does not provide. Run it on a host that provides that feature.

featuresMidiIn.doc: conditional: the plugin has a MIDI input, which an insert on a host that plays no notes never feeds; on the LV2 path an input the host cannot feed is refused at add

text.en: This plugin’s MIDI input is fed nothing. Connect a source of MIDI, or accept it runs with none.

featuresMissing.doc: unsuitable: the plugin requires a feature the host does not provide; the LV2 adapter refuses it at add from its TTL, before its binary is opened

text.en: This plugin is missing a feature it needs to run here. Provide that feature, or run it elsewhere.

featuresPortsUnreadable.doc: the plugin declares ports its reader cannot read (a port node shared by several plugins of one bundle, a port with no symbol), so none reaches the host: the bundle's data is the fault, not the layout (omx-clap-core#255)

text.en: This plugin declares ports its reader cannot read, so none of them reach the host. The fault is in the plugin’s own bundle, not in this host.

featuresProvided.doc: suitable: every feature the plugin requires is provided, and nothing in its descriptor is a caution

text.en: This plugin has every feature it needs.

featuresUnscanned.doc: unknown: the plugin's scan record has no feature list, because it was taken before the scan read one

text.en: This plugin was scanned before this field existed, so it was never checked for it. Scan it again to check.
